{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained positive sentiment (e.g., >0.50) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when recent history shows sharp price drops followed by model overcorrection.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or negative (e.g., <0.00), to avoid underestimating rebounds.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 10-15% unless sentiment strongly supports upward move.",
    "When sentiment history includes a recent negative spike (-0.25 to -0.50), delay forecast peak by 1-2 days and reduce peak value by 5-10%.",
    "For long-term (30d) forecasts, apply a 3-5% downward bias if true outcome consistently underperforms model in the first 10 days of forecast horizon.",
    "If model forecast is >15% above true outcome and sentiment is neutral, apply a ‘cooling’ correction: reduce forecast by 10% for next 3 days, then revert to baseline."
  ]
}
